premises: Low-percentage FCC metal additives (Pd, Ag, Cu) reduce the distribution of exchange energies in NiFeCoCr-based HEAs.
Heat treatment further homogenizes the magnetic exchange environment.
A narrower exchange energy distribution sharpens the second-order magnetic phase transition.
A sharper transition enhances the magnetic entropy change at low applied fields.
The high-entropy matrix inherently provides rapid heat diffusion, low hysteresis, and mechanical stability.
